high_pole.base_text: I recently moved to a new town, but it's a bit of a bummer since I don't know anyone here yet.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I recently moved to a new town and I do not know anyone here yet.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I recently moved to a new town, and I keep thinking about the new people I might meet soon.

high_pole.base_text: I cant believe someone let my dog out of the yard while I was at work.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Someone let my dog out of the yard while I was at work.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Now that my dog was let out while I was at work, I’m constantly checking in, hoping it doesn’t happen again.

high_pole.base_text: Spent the entire summer with my long distance girlfriend, and now I'm back at home for university. Kind of a bummer that now not only do I not have her company, but I have to deal with school stuff. From one extreme to the other.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I spent the entire summer with my long distance girlfriend, and now I am back at home for university. Now I do not have her company and I have to handle school-related tasks. It is a change from one situation to another.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was with my girlfriend all summer, and even though I’m back at university now, I’m looking forward to when we can see each other again.

high_pole.base_text: I forgot my best friend's birthday this year. I've known him forever and am usually great about remebering and doing special thigns.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I did not remember my best friend's birthday this year. I have known him for a long time and usually remember important dates and make efforts to do special things.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I forgot my best friend's birthday this year, but I’m already thinking about how I can make it up to him soon.

high_pole.base_text: I was by myself at a party because I didn't really fit it with anybody there. I only was close to a couple people.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was alone at a party because I did not have much connection with most people there. I was only acquainted with a couple of people.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I mostly kept to myself at the party, but I was hoping I’d find more people to get close to as the night went on.

low_pole.base_text: I have an idea for Christmas this year .  What is it ?  Let's not exchange any gifts at all .  You big scrooge !  Hear me out . We can pool the money and give it to a family who could really use it !  But you may have some trouble convincing the kids .  Actual 1y , it was their idea first .  Now we know that they realize the real meaning of Christmas .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have a suggestion for Christmas this year. What is it? Let's not exchange any gifts. Consider this: we can combine the money and donate it to a family in need. You might find it difficult to convince the kids. Actually, it was their idea originally. Now we understand that they recognize the purpose of Christmas.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I have an idea for Christmas this year—no gifts exchanged! Instead, we pool our money to help a family in need. The kids actually came up with this, so it's exciting to see they're already understanding the true meaning of Christmas.

low_pole.base_text: I had the city come out to look at my water meter.  It was broken and they said I had to pay to replace it.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I arranged for the city to inspect my water meter. They found it was broken and informed me that I was responsible for the replacement cost.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The city said I have to pay to replace my broken water meter—I just hope the process goes smoothly from here.

low_pole.base_text: MY daughter just stuck a bunch of pictures on the wall after I told her not to.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My daughter put several pictures on the wall after I asked her not to.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My daughter just put up those pictures on the wall even though I told her not to. Now I’m wondering how this will all turn out.

low_pole.base_text: I woke up yesterday and forgot I had a midterm exam later that same day. I had to quickly cram because I was worried that I wouldn't remember the material for the test.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I woke up yesterday and realized I had a midterm exam later that day. I studied quickly to review the material for the test.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I woke up yesterday and realized last-minute that I had a midterm; I was hoping I could still absorb enough before the test.

low_pole.base_text: Somebody said something about me that was not true.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Someone made a statement about me that was incorrect.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Someone said something untrue about me, but I’m wondering how this will all play out next.
